question: What services do you provide?
answer: I offer a comprehensive range of engineering services including Full-Stack Web Development, IoT & Embedded Systems design, Blockchain/Smart Contract development, and Cybersecurity consulting. I build scalable applications, secure authentication systems (biometric, OTP), hardware-software integrations, and automated workflows. Projects are scoped to combine technical excellence with robust security.

question: How does your process work?
answer:
My approach is structured and engineering-focused:
  • Discovery & Architecture: Understanding requirements, system design, and threat modeling.
  • Development & Integration: Building the core application, smart contracts, or IoT firmware.
  • Testing & Security: Vulnerability assessments, performance testing, and QA.
  • Deployment & Handoff: Delivering clean code, documentation, and production deployment.

question: What does a typical engagement cost?
answer:
Pricing depends on the scope and technical complexity of the project. I typically offer:
  • Small modules / Security audits — fixed fee.
  • Full-stack applications / IoT systems — milestone-based.
  • Ongoing maintenance & automation — monthly retainer.
I’ll propose the best model after an initial discovery call and a brief scoping conversation.

question: How long will the project take?
answer:
Timelines vary depending on the system's complexity:
  • Security audits & small scripts: 1–2 weeks.
  • Web applications & Smart Contracts: 4–8 weeks.
  • End-to-end IoT systems & complex architectures: 2–4+ months.
Every proposal includes a timeline with milestones and review points.

question: What deliverables will I receive?
answer:
Deliverables are tailored to the project and commonly include:
  • Production-ready source code (GitHub/GitLab)
  • System architecture & API documentation
  • Security audit reports & vulnerability assessments
  • Hardware schematics & IoT firmware (if applicable)
  • Smart contract code & test coverage reports

question: How do you handle security & privacy?
answer: Security is integral to my work. Depending on the project, I follow secure-by-design principles, OWASP guidelines, threat modeling, and best-practice authentication (e.g., AES/SHA, TOTP, secure biometric flows). I also advise on data minimization, encryption (in transit & at rest) and safe cloud configuration. For sensitive work, we can sign an NDA prior to any data exchange.

question: Can you build hardware proofs-of-concept?
answer: Yes. I build functional embedded proofs-of-concept (e.g., Arduino / ESP8266 / ESP32, RFID, sensors) and integrate them with cloud backends for demos. For production hardware, I collaborate with manufacturing/embedded partners and provide the system architecture and firmware handoff.

question: What are the next steps to start a project?
answer: Send a short brief via the Contact page (project goals, timeline, budget range). I’ll review and propose a 15–30 minute discovery call to align expectations and scope. After that, you’ll receive a written proposal with milestones and costs.
